text: CarePoint, Inc. is again the chosen charity beneficiary of the Virginia Slims Legends
Tour returning to Oklahoma City this October. Last year we were able to raise over
$21,000 for AIDS programs and services offered through CarePoint, Inc. thanks to
the partnership between the National AIDS Fund and Philip Morris Companies.
We are excited about working with Big Return, Inc. once again in order to achieve a
very successful fund raising event for our community. I have tried several times to
contact you or Julie Copaken by telephone. We need to address some issues right
away in order for us to begin our work. Could we get a response from you
Tickets to the tennis matches - we would like to market our fund raiser to
include tickets to our event as well as the tennis matches for those who want
to attend both. Some of the other cities have received a block of discounted
tickets through their promoters and were leverage some additional funding
for AIDS as part of promoting attendance to the matches.
Program ad - Philip Morris officials suggested that we work with the
promoters to include a one page ad about CarePoint, Inc. and AIDS services
in our area in the official program. Other cities have received a one page ad
free of charge. This helps to educate the community and ties the Legends
Tour to the local AIDS charity.
Auction items - since we will be including both a silent auction and live
auction, conducted by the tennis players, at our event, would Big Return,
Inc. be able to supply some sports-oriented auction items? We were able to
raise over $7,000 from our silent auction last year.
